text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I stroll around the academy, I spot<n>Seeking the
Pearl completely<n>absorbed in a dance.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Th-that's it! My heart... israc—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
choice_data_list: Are you okay? You shouldn't overwork yourself!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know... I shouldn't. I'm still tired<n>from my race,
but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm the precious pearl who reveals<n>possibilities to
the world! It's my duty<n>to stir people's hearts
through my<n>dance!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I need to up the beat even more! Go<n>away, fatigue
and exhaustion! No one<n>needs you here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is as enthusiastic<n>as ever, but
she seems worn out<n>from her races. I'll need to
rethink her<n>upcoming race schedule.
